# Vendored JavaScript

Unmodified builds from npm, checked by SHA-256 against the published packages.
All are MIT licensed, see `LICENSE-xterm.txt`.

| File | Package | Version |
|---|---|---|
| `xterm.js`, `xterm.css` | `@xterm/xterm` | 6.0.0 |
| `addon-fit.js` | `@xterm/addon-fit` | 0.11.0 |
| `addon-search.js` | `@xterm/addon-search` | 0.16.0 |
| `addon-unicode11.js` | `@xterm/addon-unicode11` | 0.9.0 |
| `addon-web-links.js` | `@xterm/addon-web-links` | 0.12.0 |
| `addon-webgl.js` | `@xterm/addon-webgl` | 0.19.0 |

To update: take `lib/*.js` from the npm package and keep the versions of the
addons in step with xterm.
